Forecast an Event Triggered AR update

Source: R/11-et-ar-forecast.R
forecast_et_ar.Rd

Begin with steady-condition parameters and switch once to event-condition parameters when the configured trigger is met. The recurrence state is retained across the switch, so the error series remains continuous.

Usage

forecast_et_ar(
  configuration,
  initial_errors,
  simulated,
  time = seq_along(simulated),
  lower_limit = NULL,
  time_step_minutes = 15
)

Arguments

configuration

An object from et_ar_configuration().

initial_errors

Recent observed-minus-simulated errors, newest first. Length must equal the shared AR order.

simulated

Numeric simulated values for the full projection horizon.

time

Optional timestamps or lead values matching simulated.

lower_limit

Optional lower bound applied to displayed updates.

time_step_minutes

Minutes represented by one step.

Value

An object of class et_ar_forecast. Use et_ar_series() to extract its auditable row-level table.

Examples

config <- et_ar_configuration(
  default_et_ar_steady_parameters(), event_ar_parameters(48),
  logical_et_trigger(c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, rep(TRUE, 9)))
)
result <- forecast_et_ar(
  config, initial_errors = c(0.2, 0.18, 0.16), simulated = rep(1, 12)
)
et_ar_series(result)
